title: Long review disclosure
guidance: Very long comments need a bounded preview and an obvious accessible way to reveal the complete original text and collapse it. Preserve rating, author and useful context.

decisions.title: Progressive disclosure preserves the review
decisions.reason: Over420 source characters, show a grapheme-safe preview and native Read full review / Show less. The original full Unicode text is retained without mutation.

decisions.title: Expansion is usable state
decisions.reason: Keyboard Enter/Space toggles the disclosure; appearance changes retain its expanded state and essential author/rating context stays visible.

parameters.name: Preview threshold
parameters.description: LONG_REVIEW_LENGTH420; preview uses Intl.Segmenter for the first240 graphemes, then a useful word boundary where available; CSS bounds the preview to5 lines.

parameters.name: Reading and control size
parameters.description: Full and preview text have max-inline-size68ch; the summary uses the shared inline-link color and a2.75rem minimum target.

status.human: manual guidance received; revision awaits human review
status.color: Purple rejected. Replacement slate-blue/blue-teal palette awaiting human judgment

exportNote: Decision-only extract. Rendered evidence and review history are excluded from this handoff. Human-unvisited states remain unvisited; no new visual acceptance is claimed.
